Let me think through this carefully.

In the 1998 season, Mark McGwire hit 70 home runs. The question is whose single-season home run record he broke.

Before 1998, the single-season home run record was 61, set by Roger Maris in 1961. Maris had broken Babe Ruth's record of 60 home runs (set in 1927) when he achieved this.

So when McGwire hit 70 home runs in 1998, he was breaking Roger Maris's record of 61 home runs, not Babe Ruth's record (which had already been broken decades earlier by Maris).

The majority of agents correctly identified Roger Maris, and this is indeed the correct answer.

Answer: Roger Maris
Confidence: 0.99
